closes: Point-only reporting: the signed Arrhenius gate now carries a distribution-free calibrated band with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantee.
Quantifies the honest CRO-gate uncertainty as a multiplicative pot-life factor.
does_not_close: Does NOT modify the signed Arrhenius KPI or the 66-receipt master manifest.
Does NOT promote the module out of PRE_PHASE_0 (human dual-identity keys required).
Does NOT beat the Phase-1 named pot-life baseline; 36 owned independently-mixed CRO runs still pending.
Coverage guarantee is MARGINAL over the exchangeable held-out set; family-conditional coverage is reported separately and is the open Phase-1 question.
Absolute pot-life of a thinned marine paint differs from these gel/pot-life anchors; the band is validated on the published truth table only.

G1_marginal_conformal_meets_nominal.definition: LOO (jackknife+) empirical coverage >= nominal at alpha in {0.10,0.20}

G2_family_conditional_validity.definition: leave-one-amine-class-out coverage >= nominal for EVERY class; if any class under-covers, marginal conformal is valid but NOT family-conditional -> CRO gate needs class-stratified intervals

G3_score_fail_closed.definition: nonconformity score returns None (fail-closed) on NaN/Inf/<=0 inputs

G4_mape_reproduces_signed_kpi.definition: recomputed held-out MAPE matches signed KPI to <1e-9

headline: Distribution-free conformal wraps the signed Arrhenius pot-life gate: marginal leave-one-out (jackknife+) coverage meets nominal at both 90% and 80% (G1 PASS); the group / leave-one-amine-class-out test shows marginal validity is NOT family-conditional (under-covering classes: aliphatic-polyamine,aromatic-amine); the parametric Gaussian band is MIS-calibrated. Median 90% band = x1.398531 pot-life factor. MAPE crosscheck ties to signed KPI (delta 2.8e-17).
non_circularity: The Arrhenius activation energies are external published constants (Prime 1997; Kamal & Sourour 1973; Blanco 2005), not fit to these 36 points, so the log-residuals are genuinely out-of-sample. Conformal calibration is leave-one-out (P1) and leave-one-amine-class-out (P2); no test point informs its own band.

gaussian_fit.note: signed log-residual mean/std; mean != 0 indicates directional bias

purpose: Add distribution-free calibrated prediction intervals (conformal + bootstrap) to the module's signed Arrhenius pot-life temperature-scaling gate, which currently reports only a point MAPE. Uses ONLY the already-signed 12-system x 3-held-out-temperature truth table; no new data, no model refit.
theory_reference: Conformal prediction: Vovk, Gammerman & Shafer 2005 'Algorithmic Learning in a Random World'; Lei, G'Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani & Wasserman 2018 JASA 113:1094; jackknife+ / CV+ Barber, Candes, Ramdas & Tibshirani 2021 Ann. Statist. 49:486; Mondrian/group conformal Vovk et al. 2003. Underlying model: Arrhenius (1889) k(T)=A*exp(-Ea/RT), pot_life(T)=pot_life_ref*exp[(Ea/R)(1/T-1/T_ref)], R=8.31446261815324 J/(mol.K) CODATA 2018, T_ref=295.928 K (22.78 C).
